C1808.title: iRobot Roomba J7 Home Privacy Photo Leakage Incident
C1808.summary: In December 2022, MIT Technology Review reported that iRobot Roomba J7 dev units captured private home images in 2020 (including a woman on the toilet, children), sent to Scale AI for annotation, then illicitly shared by Venezuelan annotators to private Facebook groups and Discord. iRobot confirmed 15 leaked photos were among ~2 million images shared with Scale AI. The incident exposed privacy-control failures in embodied-device data collection and third-party annotation chains, raising AI training-data compliance disputes.
